notes:
Driver for the ManiSkill Gymnasium environment TriFingerRotateCubeLevel0-v1 (native mani_skill.envs.tasks.rotate_cube:RotateCubeEnvLevel0, one of the card's ast-confirmed entry symbols). The card's family-config/GymnasiumDriver shape fits the upstream gymnasium env API, so there is no deviation from the card. Only the fake backend is served: fake.py is a pure-Python kinematic F0 stand-in for the class's reset/step/close surface and the MSTimeLimit of 250 steps; it moves the nine finger joints by the normalised pd_joint_delta_pos deltas and samples the Level-0 goal, with placeholder cube drift and reward-distance constants marked in the source. The real default state observation is a flat 32-value vector (9 qpos, 9 qvel, 3 goal_pos, 4 goal_q, 3 obj_p, 4 obj_q); the fake returns exactly that layout, not a reduced array. The upstream sim backend (gymnasium.make, which needs SAPIEN/PhysX and was not installed) was not run, and the fake was never compared with an upstream run. This package is model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null); no hardware run or human review is claimed. NOT COVERED: camera/sensor rgb, depth, segmentation and pointcloud arrays and the visual observation modes; the fake serves the default state observation only. Warnings left intentionally, matching the Gymnasium family: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset, so it makes no native call) and G8.NO_UNIT x4 for the bridge-derived integer/numeric inputs seed (reset), seed (seed class), ticks and action.values, which the bridge derives without units. G4 has no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warnings.
